What to look for: this compiles a completely ordinary, valid lib_6_7 shader
with "-MD -MF repro.d -Fo repro.cso". A correct compile with -Fo should
produce an object file and Compiler Explorer's DXC pane would then show its
disassembly. Instead, on dxc_trunk the pane reads "<No output file>" at exit
0 -- no diagnostic, no disassembly, nothing -- because requesting the
dependency file makes dxc skip compilation entirely and return success before
ever reaching the -Fo write. dxc_1_6_2112 instead rejects -MD as an unknown
argument, because that release predates the flag; it is shown for contrast,
not as a second instance of the bug.
